71400.grammar: ind, adv, abl sg of heṭṭhā

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, puriso bahukaṇṭakaṃ dāyaṃ paviseyya. tassa purato'pi kaṇṭako, pacchato'pi kaṇṭako, uttarato'pi kaṇṭako, dakkhiṇato'pi kaṇṭako, heṭṭhato'pi kaṇṭako, uparito'pi kaṇṭako. so sato'va abhikkameyya, sato'va paṭikkameyya, mā maṃ kaṇṭako'ti.
heṭṭhā kho pana tassa bhoto gotamassa pādatalesu cakkāni jātāni sahass'ārāni sanemikāni sanābhikāni sabb'ākāraparipūrāni, idam'pi tassa bhoto gotamassa mahāpurisassa mahāpurisalakkhaṇaṃ bhavati.
seyyathā'pi, poṭṭhapāda, puriso nisseṇiṃ kareyya pāsādassa ārohaṇāya tass'eva pāsādassa heṭṭhā.
yathā heṭṭhā bhāvakammesu yapaccayassa ādeso hoti tathā kattari'pi yapaccayassa ādeso kātabbo. bujjhati, vijjhati, maññati, sibbati.
heṭṭhāgopphake udake kīḷati, āpatti dukkaṭassa. udake nāvāya kīḷati, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, mahāpurisassa heṭṭhāpādatalesu cakkāni jātāni honti sahass'ārāni sanemikāni sanābhikāni sabb'ākāraparipūrāni.

71407.commentary: (ANa) heṭṭhāpāsādaṃ orohāmī'ti pāsādato heṭṭhā na otarāmi. iti maṃ cattāro māse añño sikhābaddho puriso nāma passituṃ n'ālattha.

examples.text: so kho ahaṃ, māgaṇḍiya, vassike pāsāde vassike cattāro māse nippurisehi tūriyehi paricārayamāno na heṭṭhāpāsādaṃ orohāmi.

71408.meaning1: under a chair; underneath a bench

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena aññataro bhikkhu pīṭhe cīvaraṃ nikkhipitvā. pīṭhe nisīdanaṃ nikkhipitvā… heṭṭhāpīṭhe pattaṃ nikkhipitvā vihāraṃ pāvisi.

tassa heṭṭhābhāgaṃ sodhāpetvā pākāraparikkhepaṃ kārāpetvā vālukaṃ okirāpetvā dhajapaṭākaṃ ussāpetvā vanappatiṃ alaṅ'karitvā añjaliṃ karitvā, sace puttaṃ vā dhītaraṃ vā labheyyaṃ, tumhākaṃ mahāsakkāraṃ karissāmī'ti patthanaṃ katvā pakkāmi.
tena kho pana samayena sambahulā bhikkhū heṭṭhāmigāramātupāsāde viharanti uddhatā unnaḷā capalā mukharā vikiṇṇavācā muṭṭhassatino asampajānā asamāhitā bhantacittā pākat'indriyā.
navaṃ pana bhikkhunā mañcaṃ vā pīṭhaṃ vā kārayamānena aṭṭh'aṅgulapādakaṃ kāretabbaṃ sugat'aṅgulena aññatra heṭṭhimāya aṭaniyā. taṃ atikkāmayato chedanakaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
aññataro bhikkhu heṭṭhā hutvā silaṃ uccāresi. uparimena bhikkhunā duggahitā silā heṭṭhimassa bhikkhuno matthake avatthāsi. so bhikkhu kālam'akāsi

71416.meaning1: base of a mountain; foot of a hill

examples.text: tam'enaṃ uparipabbate ṭhito sahāyako heṭṭhimapabbatapādaṃ orohitvā taṃ sahāyakaṃ bāhāyaṃ gahetvā uparipabbataṃ āropetvā muhuttaṃ assāsetvā evaṃ vadeyya, yaṃ, samma, kiṃ tvaṃ passasi uparipabbate ṭhito'ti?
(yathā heṭṭhimasutt'antaṃ, evaṃ vitthāretabbaṃ.)

71419.meaning1: who get reborn in a lower realm; who reappear lower

71421.commentary: (DNa) icchā vivicchā paraheṭhanā cā'ti taṇhālakkhaṇā icchā ca, macchariyalakkhaṇā vivicchā ca, vihiṃsālakkhaṇā paraheṭhanā ca.

examples.text: kodho mosavajjaṃ nikati ca dubbho, kadariyatā atimāno usūyā, icchā vivicchā paraheṭhanā ca, lobho ca doso ca mado ca moho, etesu yuttā anirāmagandhā, āpāyikā nivutabrahmalokāti.
na pāṇidaṇḍehi pan'ātha leḍḍunā, satthena vā maraṇavadhena vā pana, ubbādhanāya paritajjanāya vā, na heṭhayī janatam'aheṭhako ahu.
ko hi tassa janen'attho'ti tassa aññajanassa aññena janena taṇhāvasena assitena dosavasena heṭhitena vā ko attho.

71426.meaning2: is harassed; is hassled; is annoyed

examples.text: te bhikkhuṃ pañhaṃ vā puccheyyuṃ vādaṃ vā āropeyyuṃ akkoseyyuṃ paribhāseyyuṃ roseyyuṃ viroseyyuṃ hiṃseyyuṃ vihiṃseyyuṃ heṭheyyuṃ viheṭheyyuṃ ghāteyyuṃ upaghāteyyuṃ upaghātaṃ vā kareyyuṃ.
dīgharattañ'h'etaṃ, bhikkhave, assutavato puthujjanassa ajjhositaṃ mamāyitaṃ parāmaṭṭhaṃ
maraṇañ'h'etaṃ, sunakkhatta, ariyassa vinaye yo sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāy'āvattati, maraṇamattañ'h'etaṃ, sunakkhatta, dukkhaṃ yaṃ aññataraṃ saṃkiliṭṭhaṃ āpattiṃ āpajjati.

taṃ kiṃ maññasi, gāmaṇi, api nu so puriso mahato janakāyassa āyācanahetu vā thomanahetu vā pañjalikā anuparisakkanahetu vā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjeyyā'ti? no h'etaṃ, bhante.

etha tumhe, kālāmā, mā anussavena, mā param'parāya, mā itikirāya, mā piṭakasampadānena, mā takkahetu, mā nayahetu, mā ākāraparivitakkena, mā diṭṭhinijjhānakkhantiyā, mā bhabbarūpatāya, mā samaṇo no garū'ti.

yo'pi hetu yo'pi paccayo cakkhuviññāṇassa uppādāya, so'pi hetu so'pi paccayo anicco vipariṇāmī aññathābhāvī. aniccaṃ kho pana, bhikkhave, paccayaṃ paṭicca uppannaṃ cakkhuviññāṇaṃ kuto niccaṃ bhavissati!
aṭṭh'ime, bhikkhave, hetū aṭṭha paccayā ādibrahmacariyikāya paññāya appaṭiladdhāya paṭilābhāya, paṭiladdhāya bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya bhāvanāya pāripūriyā saṃvattanti. katame aṭṭha?

71435.meaning1: for; for the purpose; for the sake (of)
71435.commentary: (MNa) attahetu vā parahetu vā'ti attano vā parassa vā hatthapād'ādihetu vā dhanahetu vā. āmisakiñcikkhahetu vā'ti ettha āmisan'ti lābho adhippeto. kiñcikkhan'ti yaṃ vā taṃ vā appamattakaṃ. antamaso tittira-vaṭṭaka-sappipiṇḍa-navanītapiṇḍ'ādi-mattakassa'pi lañjassa hetū'ti attho.

examples.text: iti attahetu vā parahetu vā āmisakiñcikkhahetu vā na sampajānamusā bhāsitā hoti.
varaṃ te, bhikkhu, tiṇhena govikantanena kucchi parikanto, na tv'eva varaṃ yaṃ ratt'andhakāratimisāyaṃ kucchihetu piṇḍāya carasī'ti.
evarūpe mahabbhaye'ti edise mahati maraṇabhaye upaṭṭhite. hetuatthe vā etaṃ bhummavacanaṃ.

71438.meaning1: having a cause; with a basis; with grounds

examples.text: dassanena pahātabbahetukā dhammā. bhāvanāya pahātabbahetukā dhammā. n'eva dassanena na bhāvanāya pahātabbahetukā dhammā
yassa vanathajā na santi keci, vinibandhāya bhavāya hetukappā, so bhikkhu jahāti orapāraṃ, urago jiṇṇam'iva tacaṃ purāṇaṃ.

71443.meaning1: breaking up of the cause; dissolution of the condition; disintegration of the precondition

examples.text: na'y'idaṃ attakataṃ bimbaṃ, na'y'idaṃ parakataṃ aghaṃ, hetuṃ paṭicca sambhūtaṃ, hetubhaṅgā nirujjhati.

examples.text: sakkāyavūpakāso me, hetubhūto mam'ābhavī, manaso vūpakāsassa, saṃsaggabhayadassino.

sāvako'pi khīṇ'āsavo sāvakabodhiyā hetubhūte puññasambhāre sambharanto pubbayogaṃ pubbacariyaṃ gatapaccāgatavattaṃ pūrento carimabhave nibbattanto anukkamena viññutaṃ patvā saṃsāre ādīnavaṃ disvā pabbajjāya cetayamāno pabbajjaṃ matthakaṃ pāpetvā sīl'ādīni paripūrento dhutadhamme samādāya…
heturūpaṃ, bhante, bhagavā āha, saheturūpaṃ, bhante, bhagavā āha, n'atthi so samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā yo saki'd'eva sabbaṃ ñassati, sabbaṃ dakkhiti, n'etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjatī'ti.
asādhāraṇena ca ñāṇena samannāgato bhavissāmi, hetu ca me sudiṭṭho bhavissati, hetusamuppannā ca dhammā

71449.grammar: ind, adv, abl sg of hetu
71449.meaning1: by cause; according to the reason
71449.commentary: (MNa) ṭhānaso hetuso'ti paccayato c'eva hetuto ca. tattha gati-upadhi-kāla-payogā vipākassa ṭhānaṃ. kammaṃ hetu. imassa pana ñāṇassa vitthārakathā atth'ekaccāni pāpakāni kammasamādānāni gatisampattipaṭibāḷhāni na vipaccantī'tiādinā (vibha. 810) nayena abhidhamme āgatā'y'eva.

examples.text: yam'pi, sāriputta, tathāgato atīt'ānāgatapaccuppannānaṃ kammasamādānānaṃ ṭhānaso hetuso vipākaṃ yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti, idam'pi, sāriputta, tathāgatassa tathāgatabalaṃ hoti yaṃ balaṃ āgamma tathāgato āsabhaṃ ṭhānaṃ paṭijānāti, parisāsu sīhanādaṃ nadati, brahmacakkaṃ pavatteti.

71450.meaning1: who is a proponent of the doctrine of causality; believing in the theory that everything has a reason

examples.text: santaṃ'y'eva kho pana hetuṃ n'atthi hetū'ti āha, ye te arahanto hetuvādā tesam'ayaṃ paccanīkaṃ karoti.
jātidhammā h'ete, bhikkhave, upadhayo. etth'āyaṃ gathito mucchito ajjhāpanno attanā jātidhammo samāno jātidhammaṃ'y'eva pariyesati.
sātaṃ asātañ'ca kutonidānā, kismiṃ asante na bhavanti h'ete, vibhavaṃ bhavañ'c'āpi yam'etam'atthaṃ, etaṃ me pabrūhi yatonidānaṃ.
kacci'ttha, bhante, na koci gihī ahosi odātavasano'ti? na h'ettha, āvuso, koci gihī ahosi odātavasano'ti. sādhu, bhante, yadettha na koci gihī ahosi odātavasano'ti.

71453.commentary: (Kacc) hetv'atthe, kasmā hetunā, kena hetunā, kissa hetunā, kasmā nu tumhaṃ daharā na mīyare, kasmā idh'eva maraṇaṃ bhavissati icc'evam'ādi.

examples.text: 438, 540. dhātūhi ṇe ṇaya ṇāpe ṇāpayā kāritāni hetv'atthe.
sabbehi dhātūhi ṇe ṇaya ṇāpe ṇāpaya'icc'ete paccayā honti kāritasaññā ca hetv'atthe.

71459.commentary: (DHPa) hemantagimhisū'ti hemantagimhesu'pi cattāro māse idañ'c'idañ'ca karonto idh'eva vasissāmī'ti evaṃ diṭṭhadhammikasamparāyikaṃ atthaṃ ajānanto bālo vicinteti.

examples.text: idha vassaṃ vasissāmi, idha hem'antagimhisu, iti bālo vicinteti, antarāyaṃ na bujjhati.
utu'kkhānaṃ, hem'ant'ādīnaṃ tiṇṇaṃ utūnaṃ, ettakaṃ atikkantaṃ, ettakaṃ avasiṭṭhan'ti. evaṃ utu-ācikkhanaṃ kataṃ kiṃ?
examples.source: VIN PAT PK saṅghuposatha pubbakaraṇādi vidhi

71460.meaning1: winter, summer and rainy season; cold, hot and wet season
71460.compound: dvanda (hemanta ca gimha ca vassāna ca)
71460.commentary: (VAt) hem'antagimhavassānaṃ tiṇṇaṃ utūnan'ti ettha hemanta-utu nāma aparakattikakāḷapakkhassa pāṭipadato paṭṭhāya phaggunapuṇṇamapariyosānā cattāro māsā. gimha-utu nāma phaggunassa kāḷapakkhapāṭipadato paṭṭhāya āsāḷhipuṇṇamapariyosānā cattāro māsā. vassāna-utu nāma āsāḷhassa kāḷapakkhapāṭipadato paṭṭhāya aparakattikapuṇṇamapariyosānā cattāro māsā.

examples.text: evaṃ utu-ācikkhanaṃ. utūn'īdha pana sāsane hem'anta-gimha-vassānānaṃ vasena tīṇi honti.

71461.meaning1: winter; for the winter; related to the winter season
71461.meaning2: belonging to the winter, icy cold

examples.text: atha kho, bhikkhave, bandhumā rājā vipassissa kumārassa tayo pāsāde kārāpesi, ekaṃ vassikaṃ ekaṃ hem'antikaṃ ekaṃ gimhikaṃ, pañca kāmaguṇāni upaṭṭhāpesi
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, sāmuddikāya nāvāya vettabandhanabaddhāya vassamāsāni udake pariyādāya hem'antikena thalaṃ ukkhittāya vāt'ātapaparetāni vettabandhanāni.
ayaṃ hem'anto'tu, asmiñ'ca utumhi aṭṭha uposathā, iminā pakkhena eko uposatho sampatto, eko uposathā atikkantā, cha uposathā avasiṭṭhā.

71463.meaning1: golden coloured; with a golden complexion

passa sundari satthāraṃ, hemavaṇṇaṃ harittacaṃ, adantānaṃ dametāraṃ, sambuddham'akutobhayaṃ.

71464.commentary: (SNPa) te ten'eva kukkuccena upahatāsayattā kālaṃ katvā sagge nibbattitum'asakkontā ekācariyo himavati hemavate pabbate nibbatti hemavato yakkho'ti nāmena.

examples.text: kacci mano supaṇihito, (iti hemavato yakkho) sabbabhūtesu tādino, kacci iṭṭhe aniṭṭhe ca, saṅkappassa vasīkatā.

ayaṃ me puggalo khamati imesaṃ catunnaṃ puggalānaṃ abhikkantataro ca paṇītataro ca. taṃ kissa hetu? abhikkantā h'esā, bho gotama, yadidaṃ upekkhā'ti.
bāhirā h'esā rakkhā, n'esā rakkhā ajjhattikā, tasmā tesaṃ arakkhito attā.
kadā nu'haṃ dubbacanena vutto, tatonimittaṃ vimano na hessaṃ, atho pasattho'pi tatonimittaṃ, tuṭṭho na hessaṃ tadidaṃ kadā me.

71475.grammar: fut, reflx 1st sg of hessati, intrans (+nom)
71475.meaning1: I myself will be; I myself will become

examples.text: kadā nu'haṃ dubbacanena vutto, tatonimittaṃ vimano na hessaṃ, atho pasattho'pi tatonimittaṃ, tuṭṭho na hessaṃ tadidaṃ kadā me.
sace kho, mārisa, sabbassa sabbattena ananubhūtaṃ, tadabhiññāya mā h'eva te rittakam'eva ahosi, tucchakam'eva ahosī'ti.
na h'eva saccāni bahūni nānā, aññatra saññāya niccāni loke, takkañ'ca diṭṭhīsu pakappayitvā, saccaṃ musā'ti dvayadhammam'āhu.

71477.commentary: (ANa) mā h'evan'ti'ssa vacanīyo'ti yasmā abhūtabyākaraṇaṃ byākaroti, tasmā mā evaṃ bhaṇī'ti vattabbo.

examples.text: so mā h'evan'ti'ssa vacanīyo, m'āyasmā, evaṃ avaca, mā bhagavantaṃ abbhācikkhi, na hi sādhu bhagavato abbhakkhānaṃ, na hi bhagavā evaṃ vadeyya.
mā h'evaṃ, āvuso ariṭṭha, avaca, mā bhagavantaṃ abbhācikkhi, na hi sādhu bhagavato abbhakkhānaṃ, na hi bhagavā evaṃ vadeyya.
taṃ tathāvādiniṃ buddho, mamaṃ so etadabravi, na h'evaṃ vandiyā buddhā, yathā vandasi gotamī.

71480.meaning1: will be; will become; will exist

examples.text: yaṃ vo kiccaṃ sarīrena, taṃ karotha yadicchatha, na me tappaccayā tattha, doso pemañ'ca hehiti.
vuṭṭhamhi deve caturaṅgule tiṇe, saṃpupphite meghanibhamhi kānane, nag'antare viṭapisamo sayissaṃ, taṃ me mudū hehiti tūlasannibhaṃ.

71481.meaning1: you will be; you will become

examples.text: ārammaṇe taṃ balasā nibandhisaṃ, nāgaṃ'va thambhamhi daḷhāya rajjuyā, taṃ me suguttaṃ satiyā subhāvitaṃ, anissitaṃ sabbabhavesu hehisi.
paññāya chetvā vipath'ānusārinaṃ, yogena niggayha pathe nivesiya, disvā samudayaṃ vibhavañ'ca sambhavaṃ, dāy'ādako hehisi aggavādino.
bahūhi saddā paccūhā, khamitabbā tapassinā, na tena maṅku hotabbaṃ, na hi tena kilissati.
kathañ'c'ānanda appaṇidhāya bhāvanā hoti?
yassa kassaci, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno abhijjhālussa abhijjhā appahīnā hoti, byāpannacittassa byāpādo appahīno hoti, kodhanassa kodho appahīno hoti, upanāhissa upanāho appahīno hoti
akkheyyañ'ca pariññāya, akkhātāraṃ na maññati, tañ'hi tassa na hotī'ti, yena naṃ vajjā na tassa atthi.
idaṃ vadāmī'ti na tassa hoti, dhammesu niccheyya samuggahītaṃ, passañ'ca diṭṭhīsu anuggahāya, ajjhattasantiṃ pacinaṃ adassaṃ.
na kho pan'etaṃ, nigrodha, evaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ. yo eva vo ācariyo, so eva vo ācariyo hotu. siyā kho pana te, nigrodha, evam'assa, uddesā no cāvetu'kāmo samaṇo gotamo evam'āhā'ti.

upanikkhittaṃ vā sādiyeyyā'ti idaṃ ayyassa hotū'ti upanikkhittaṃ sādiyati, nissaggiyaṃ hoti.

examples.text: sace, hotu, bhante, āhariyissatī'ti bhaṇati, corā vattabbā, manussā idh'ūpacaranti apasakkathā'ti.

71491.meaning1: wanting to be; wishing to become
71491.commentary: (VINa) yasmā pana gihī vā upāsako vā ārāmiko vā sāmaṇero vā hutvā dānasaraṇasīlasaṃvar'ādīhi saggamaggaṃ vā jhānavimokkh'ādīhi mokkhamaggaṃ vā ārādhetuṃ bhabbo hoti, tasm'āssa gihi'ādibhāvo visuddhi nāma hoti, tasmā taṃ visuddhiṃ apekkhanato, visuddh'āpekkho'ti vuccati. ten'eva c'assa padabhājane, gihī vā hotu'kāmo'ti-ādi vuttaṃ.

examples.text: visuddh'āpekkho'ti gihī vā hotu'kāmo upāsako vā hotu'kāmo ārāmiko vā hotu'kāmo sāmaṇero vā hotu'kāmo.

so lābhasakkāraṃ jigucchanto pabbajjaṃ anupagantvā, pahomi c'āhaṃ lābh'ālābh'ādīsu nibbikāro hotun'ti attānaṃ takkento, visesato para-paribhava-sahan'ādi-paṭipadaṃ pūrento upekkhāpāramiṃ matthakaṃ pāpessāmī'ti
visuddh'āpekkho'ti gihī vā hotu'kāmo upāsako vā hotu'kāmo ārāmiko vā hotu'kāmo sāmaṇero vā hotu'kāmo.

71493.meaning1: there is just; there exists some

examples.text: tesaṃ no, bhante, amhākaṃ hot'eva kaṅkhā hoti vicikicchā, ko su nāma imesaṃ bhavataṃ samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ saccaṃ āha, ko musā'ti? alañ'hi vo, kālāmā, kaṅkhituṃ alaṃ vicikicchituṃ. kaṅkhanīy'eva pana vo ṭhāne vicikicchā uppannā.

71494.meaning1: may you all be!; you all must be!; I pray you all may be!

examples.text: kiṃ nu kho tumhe āyasmanto atibāḷhaṃ mayi byāvaṭā yāva idān'āhaṃ sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāy'āvattissāmī'ti. so sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāy'āvattitvā evam'āha, idāni kho tumhe āyasmanto attamanā hothā'ti?
te atthaladdhā sukhitā, viruḷhā buddhasāsane, arogā sukhitā hotha, saha sabbehi ñātibhī'ti.

71496.meaning1: may they be!; they must be!

examples.text: abyāpannacitto hoti appaduṭṭhamanasaṅkappo ime sattā averā hontu abyāpajjā anīghā sukhī attānaṃ pariharantū'ti
saṅkhārā ca h'idaṃ, bhikkhave, attā abhavissaṃsu, na'y'idaṃ saṅkhārā ābādhāya saṃvatteyyuṃ, labbhetha ca saṅkhāresu, evaṃ me saṅkhārā hontu, evaṃ me saṅkhārā mā ahesun'ti.

71498.meaning1: let us be; may we be; we must be

examples.text: rājā kho mahāvijito mahāyaññaṃ yajati, hand'assa mayaṃ anuyāgino homā'ti.
alaṃ, āvuso, mā socittha, mā paridevittha, sumuttā mayaṃ tena mahāsamaṇena. upaddutā ca homa, idaṃ vo kappati, idaṃ vo na kappatī'ti.
